q1_issues.issue: The instruction set makes an indefinite "a/an" subject GENERIC in a copular predication (Existential section: witness only with a verbal predicate), so this should be the kind-level (Inheritance crate large) at the empirical generic (STV 0.9 0.9), not a witness carrying two Member atoms at 1.0 0.99.

q2_gaps: respect / dimension PP on a copular adjective ("large in size", "red in colour", "similar in shape") — no licensed attachment: Measure needs a magnitude+unit, Degree takes an intensifier level or forKind, and the preposition-named oblique is defined for event PPs, so the phrase is simply dropped
notes: If the witness reading were the right one, the encoding would be correct (a property on a minted sk_ symbol does attach by Member), so the sole defect is the individual-vs-kind choice the copular-indefinite rule settles. Dropping "in size" costs no truth-conditional content, but the instruction set provides no way to record it.
